newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec mine industry to review financing practices.
newsitem.headline: Quebec mine industry to review financing practices.

text.p: Representatives of Quebec's mining industry said on Wednesday that they planned to review financing practices for mining companies in the province.

Paul Archer, president of the Quebec Prospecters Association, said in a statement that the review was needed to maintain public confidence in the financial markets and in Quebec's financing process for mining companies after the anxiety caused by the Bre-X Minerals Ltd saga.

Representatives of the prospectors association, the Quebec Mining Association and the Quebec Association of Geologists and Geophysicists have formed a working committee. They expect to undertake consultations with the Quebec Securities Commission and the Montreal Exchange.
The working group will examine the financing practices and may propose changes, if needed, to reaffirm public confidence in the financial markets.
